type_claim_finding.guard_reading_before: lint_citation_types exits 1; stderr carries `::error::…:172 TYPE CLAIM WITH NO CACHED METADATA — prose calls PMCID PMC9489176 "a review"`. 13 errors total across the tree, of which this is one.
type_claim_finding.verdict: REFUTED. PubMed does not assign PMID 36103645 the `Review` publication type. Its `article_types` are exactly `Journal Article` and `Research Support, N.I.H., Extramural`.
type_claim_finding.why_this_is_more_than_a_lint: The ~70%-EWSR1 background figure and this route's ONLY positive EMC observation (the PGR::NR4A3 index case) are the same record. Calling it a review presents a single primary report's background sentence as synthesised literature, which is the exact misattribution class `citation-article-types.json` was created for on 2026-08-26 (see that file's `_why_it_exists`).
type_claim_finding.the_ledger_row_alone_does_not_fix_the_ga: Read from research/manuscripts/lint_citation_types.py:88-92 (`TYPE_RULES["review"] = ("Review", "Systematic Review")`) and :293 (`if not set(TYPE_RULES[word]) & set(rec["article_types"])` → error). With the row added, that intersection is empty, so the error changes from NO CACHED METADATA to a type DISAGREEMENT and the exit code stays 1. Both diffs are required; neither alone clears the gate. This is a code reading, not an executed demonstration — no attempt was made to run the guard against a modified tracked tree.

reach_rederivation.method: Wilson 95% score interval, upper bound, k = 0, z = 1.959963984540054. Recomputed from scratch in stdlib math and compared digit for digit against research/modalities/hormone-partner-lane.json -> reach.
reach_rederivation.verdict: All three committed bounds reproduce to the last printed digit.

denominator_discrepancy_found.statement: The owning artifact research/manuscripts/degrader/nr4a3-emc-biology-evidence.md (Hypothesis 2, pillar 1) records Agaram as "26 cases: 16/7/1". 16 + 7 + 1 = 24, not 26. Two of the 26 are unaccounted for in the stated partner breakdown.
denominator_discrepancy_found.contrast: The Huang row is internally consistent: 46 + 9 + 2 + 1 = 58.
denominator_discrepancy_found.does_it_move_the_headline: No, but it moves the bound. k = 0 for PGR and GREB1 either way, so the DIRECTION is unchanged. If only the 24 cases with a named partner call are counted as partner-genotyped, the Agaram bound widens from 0.1287289218592153 to 0.13797620467498017 and the pooled bound from 0.04373172841465988 (n = 84) to 0.04475062369010032 (n = 82).
denominator_discrepancy_found.status: OPEN AND NOT RESOLVED HERE. Whether the two unaccounted cases were partner-genotyped with another partner, were NR4A3-rearranged without a partner call, or are a transcription slip in this repository's summary cannot be settled from the held artifacts — the Agaram primary table was not retrieved in this lane. Recorded as a discrepancy, not corrected.
denominator_discrepancy_found.prior_lane_note: P6-PUB-NR-OUTSIDE-NR4A3-paper-step.md repeats "26: 16 / 7 / 1" without flagging the sum.
